subject: Important Update: New Payment Options Available
body: Dear valued customer, We are excited to announce that we have expanded our payment options to make it more convenient for you to settle your bills. You can now pay via credit card, bank transfer, or PayPal. We believe these additional options will provide you with greater flexibility and ease when managing your finances. If you have any questions or need assistance, please don't hesitate to reach out to our customer support team. Thank you for choosing our services.
